text:
jamie: day1 onboarding hiccup — I can open console.staging but /flags returns 403. Anyone know which role I should have?
elaine: @jamie welcome! usually it's the staging-flag-read group in Okta. Did you accept the provisioning email?
jamie: I accepted the invite and SSO says I'm in the "staging-access" app. I ran a quick curl to the flags API and got a 403 with this payload:
```
$ curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/flags
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"forbidden","message":"missing:console.flag.read"}
```
kyle: quick check — are you using your SSO session token or a service token? SSO sessions sometimes don't surface group claims until mapped.
jamie: using the browser SSO. No service tokens yet.
devex-bot: JIT access request created for jamie — request id #472 (expires in 4h). Approvers: infra-team, elaine.
elaine: I kicked off a short-lived staging-flag-admin grant while we debug the mapping. Try refreshing.
jamie: refreshed, still 403. CLI still shows missing permission.
infra-oncall: triggered Okta->RBAC sync for staging mappings. Noted a mapping rule missing the "staging-flag-read" claim, pushing fix now.
jamie: will retry in a bit. Thanks.
infra-oncall: sync complete. mapping rule added: Okta group "rw-staging-flag-read" -> RBAC "console.flag.read".
jamie: works now :tada: I can see flags in the UI. Huge thanks.
jamie: quick follow-up — what's the preferred way to toggle a canary for my feature in staging?
kyle: interactive: use Console UI canary rollout. Scripted: use rwctl tool:
```
rwctl flags toggle --env staging --flag new-widget-enable --on --reason "jamie onboarding smoke" --actor jamie
```
elaine: audit note — we granted jamie staging-flag-admin for 4h. If you need an extension ping me with justification. Use `--reason` for audit.
jamie: got it — will use rwctl and include reasons. One more: who owns prod flag toggles? I won't touch prod without approval.
harper: prod flips are ops/product-ops controlled — require runbook and cross-team signoff. We can schedule a controlled rollout for tests.
jamie: perfect, thanks everyone. Leaving a quick checklist for future new hires: 1) accept Okta invite 2) wait for RBAC mapping sync (or ping infra) 3) request short-lived admin via devex-bot 4) use rwctl with --reason for audit.
elaine: love the checklist, please add to onboarding doc.
jamie: will add and link the rwctl snippet. Thanks all!
